person.name: Bowen Harman
person.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-17.] Husband of a daughter of Whittington Clark of Indian River Hundred; received her share ($5.80) in the 22 Aug 1837 distribution. Whether he is the same man as Bowen Harmon (d. 1911) who later married Lydia Clark (b. 1834) is NOT settled by the probate and stays an open question; the profiles are kept separate.
